changelog: Fixed critical server tick lag (0.3-0.6ms) by replacing per-tick blocking database inserts with an in-memory price history cache.
Replaced continuous single-item synchronous database inserts with periodic asynchronous batch persistence.
Added in-memory society balance caching to eliminate database query spam during society stock calculations.
Instant chart data retrieval directly from memory without loading the MySQL database.
Integrated automatic remote version checking system (server/version.lua).
